answer: Make each new key post a 20,000 POA anchor bond that unlocks only after random spot audits. Each close, 3% of answers get a blind re-grade by 5 fresh graders, and a key caught recycling text loses its bond to the grader pool. One honest key risks little, but a farm of 300 keys stakes 6M POA, and one hit per key wipes it out. A burst of new keys arriving like a comet tail doubles the audit rate for that cohort. Audit picks come from a public beacon and every slash is logged, plain as pigment on paper.
